subject: Accelerator cohort credit handoff & eligibility review
messages:
From: Aditi Menon <aditi@lighthouselabs.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: cohort credit top-up for Lighthouse Labs accelerator

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the intro at the summit — excited to have Lighthouse Labs in the upcoming Redwood accelerator cohort (kicked off Oct 18). We had one of our partners scale their ML proof-of-concept on Redwood during the trial and the team is asking whether we can get a supplemental credit allocation + a 30-day trial extension to cover the first two demo cycles.

Quick context:
- Cohort size: 12 teams, but only 3 expect heavy inference (NLP embeddings + chat)
- Estimated baseline usage: ~45k tokens/day for two dev teams, spikes up to ~120k tokens/day during demo week
- Compliance: no PII in training prompts, logs retained for 30 days

What we’re asking: 60k token credit top-up and a 30-day trial extension tied to the accelerator cohort timeline. We can provide a roster and a short usage estimate (attached).

Attachments: cohort_roster.csv, usage_estimate.xlsx

Can you confirm eligibility and next steps? We have a doc-sign process on our side if needed.

—Aditi
Aditi Menon
Founder, Lighthouse Labs
aditi@lighthouselabs.co
https://lighthouselabs.co
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Menon <aditi@lighthouselabs.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credit top-up for Lighthouse Labs accelerator

Hi Aditi — great to meet you (and congrats on acceptance). I reviewed the roster and usage estimate you attached — thanks for the detail.

Short answer: we can typically support a conditional top-up and an extension for accelerator cohorts, subject to a couple qualifiers. To speed this along, can you confirm the following by EOD Monday?

- Which teams will need dedicated seats vs shared API access? (names ok)
- Expected peak QPS and average sequence length for the busiest demo (so we can size batching)
- Any special data residency requirements (EU/APAC)

Prelim offer (subject to sign-off from deals/compliance):
- 60,000 token credit top-up
- 30-day trial extension starting Oct 18
- Approval conditioned on: cohort manifest + usage profile + agreement to standard accelerator usage terms (we’ll send a one-page addendum)

I’m looping Marissa to coordinate operational handoff. If that all looks fine, we’ll route a one-page credit addendum for signature (DocuSign) and have Finance provision the credit.

Best,
Priyom Das
Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

On Sat, Oct 9, 2027 at 11:03 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I’m looping Marissa to coordinate operational handoff.

Thanks — answers below inline.

- Seats: 2 dedicated dev seats (Team Sigma & Team Nova), remaining teams will use shared API keys
- Peak: ~6 QPS during demo windows; avg seq length ~220 tokens (multi-turn demos)
- Residency: US only (no EU/APAC)

We’ve attached a cleaned cohort manifest and a short slide with demo cadence. Happy to sign the addendum; prefer DocuSign.

Attachments: cohort_roster.csv (updated), demo_cadence.pdf

Let me know if you need any additional info — we’re trying to finalize infra before CI begins next week.

Best,
Aditi
